title: Ed4All coverage_map.json
description: Top-level objective-keyed coverage table linking objectives -> chunks -> questions -> training_pairs across the full pipeline. Built by lib/aggregators/coverage_map.py::CoverageMapAggregator post-workflow and emitted at <libv2_course>/coverage_map.json (or <trainforge_dir>/coverage_map.json when archival hasn't run). Worker W3.E.

course_code.description: Operator-facing course code so cross-run diffs key cleanly.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the build call.

objectives.description: Per-objective coverage rows, sorted by objective_id.

chunks.description: Chunk ids whose learning_outcome_refs[] cite this objective.

questions.description: Question ids whose objective_id / objective_ids[] cite this objective.

answers_grounded_in_chunks.description: Subset of questions[] whose source_chunks[] intersect this objective's chunks[] list (questions that BOTH cite the objective AND ground their answer in a chunk that itself cites the same objective). Day-1 grounding signal; Wave 4 candidate replaces this with per-objective cosine similarity.

training_pairs.description: Instruction + preference pair ids whose lo_refs[] cite this objective.

orphan_objectives.description: Objective ids whose chunks[] AND questions[] AND training_pairs[] are all empty.

orphan_chunks.description: Chunk ids whose learning_outcome_refs[] is empty OR cites no extant objective.

orphan_questions.description: Question ids whose objective_id / objective_ids[] is empty OR cites no extant objective.
